caption: The drawing is rendered in grayscale, and it depicts a single object from three different perspectives: a three-dimensional angled view, a top-down view, and a side elevation view. The object resembles a flat, leaf-shaped trivet or decorative ironwork with a rounded handle. The main body of the object is an elongated teardrop shape, featuring an openwork design consisting of intersecting curved bands and five circular patterns, each with a star-like motif at its center. The round handle at the narrower end also displays a star-shaped pattern. The side elevation view shows the object supported by two perpendicular legs, elevating it above the surface. There is a small linear scale for measurement included to the left of the top-down view. The artist’s name, James O’Mara, is inscribed in the lower right corner of the drawing. The overall composition is centered on an off-white background with minimal border lines.
title: Trivet
